name: Yonamine Toshio
source:
"The burly bear that inhabits the store."
He is the proprietor of the Yonamine Store and Jun's father.
Though awkward and unsociable—traits hardly suited for customer service—customers still come, thanks to it being the largest store in the village.
According to Jun, he's apparently scary when angry.
